name: eden-rework-2021
author: akreao
description: Eden Group as kRO reworked it in April 2021: new gear quests and Administrators, six mission boards with champion hunts and deliveries, cave shortcuts, Odin's Past, Nyang Time's consumable converter, and English quest text. Replaces the old Eden gear and mission NPCs while on.

settings.label: Permanent shadow gear
settings.description: Administrator Emil hands out shadow gear permanently instead of renting it, as kRO does.

settings.label: Shadow gear rental (hours)
settings.description: How long Administrator Emil's shadow gear rentals last. Ignored while shadow gear is permanent.

settings.label: Eden Coin multiplier
settings.description: Multiplies the Eden Coins that mission board rewards give. 1 is kRO's amount.

settings.label: Premium consumable drops
settings.description: Any monster you kill has a small chance to give one of the premium consumables Nyang Time converts (Eden Group, 2nd floor). Not in kRO, where they come from the cash shop.

settings.label: Premium drop chance (per 10,000 kills)
settings.description: Chance per kill, out of 10,000. 10 is 0.1%; 1 is 0.01%, the same as a card. Ignored while premium drops are off.
